note: Bailey County, TX: Texas counties generally lack zoning power (Local Gov't Code ch. 231). Muleshoe, the largest city, has Chapter 14 Zoning on eCode360 marked reserved for future use with no districts. No zoning district layer found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or in county/city GIS search; the county's GIS offerings are parcel/property data only (texascountygisdata.com, taxnetusa, smartsiteplan viewer with no zoning layer).
